summary: Marion County site on the Oregon lookout list as Camp 16, a tree lookout in Clackamas-Marion FPA land; the list is the only source and gives no dates, staffing or status.

evidence.supports: site name Camp 16 in the Marion County list

evidence.quote: A lookout tree is a simple fire lookout tower created by attaching a ladder or a series of spikes to a tall straight tree with a view of the surrounding lands, allowing rangers or fire crews to conveniently climb the tree to survey their surroundings.

evidence.supports: platform trees with a platform on the trunk top
evidence.quote: A more elaborate version often created a platform on top of the tree trunk
building a railed wooden platform on the resulting stump

evidence.supports: watcher housed by a tent or shelter at the base
evidence.quote: Accommodation for the watcher was provided by a tent or shelter at the bottom of the tree.

notes_for_editor: Only the Oregon list entry describes this site. It gives the name, Marion County, the agency line Clackamas-Marion FPA, the section (8S-2E-22) and the type Tree, and nothing on dates, staffing, fate or access. Two web searches found no other Camp 16 lookout source; the name may be a numbered camp or a site name. The brief's kind is unknown while the list says Tree, which maps to the kind value tree. It is not proposed as a correction because unknown is not an error. The brief coordinates (44.8601, -122.4235) came from the west_us_lookouts record and were not checked. The FPA abbreviation is as the list gives it; the full name was not confirmed. A check with ODF Clackamas-Marion or Santiam district staff, or the Forest Fire Lookout Association Oregon chapter, may turn up the history.
